brief:
Displaced families in Gaza are lining their tent shelters with sandbags to shield themselves from Israeli gunfire, Drop Site News reported. The measure reflects the frequency of shootings targeting Palestinians in the territory, with families positioning sandbags on the sides of their shelters that face east toward Israeli military positions.

Shootings of Palestinians have become routine enough that families now routinely place sandbags as a defensive layer in their displacement camps.
dek: Shootings of Palestinians have become so frequent that displaced families are placing sandbags on the sides of shelters that face east toward Israeli troops to try and protect themselves from gunfire.
title: Gaza Palestinians fortify tents with sandbags against Israeli gunfire
